entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Support ComplexType property for temporal table validity CLR mapping #39564
  • Migrations: Down() drops a database-level object (Npgsql collation) before reverting the columns that use it #39563

PullRequests

Created

  • Add an EFMigrationsOutputDir project property as the default --output-dir #39568
    community-contribution
  • Let migrations remove find the migration files via --output-dir #39567
    community-contribution
  • Report the resolved path when writing scripts and document the base for --output #39566
    community-contribution
  • Place the model snapshot in --output-dir when it is specified #39565
    community-contribution
  • Make service provider context discovery best-effort in the tools #39562
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Translate primitive collections projected through set operations #39561
    community-contribution
  • Prune skip navigation includes in ExecuteUpdate/ExecuteDelete #39515
    community-contribution
